defaultData.summary: Highly motivated Flutter developer with a strong background in software development, object-oriented programming and database systems. Actively seeking a challenging role to learn and grow within a professional environment. Demonstrates solid skills to solve real-world problems through critical thinking and team-based collaborations. A dedicated team player with a passion for contributing to a dynamic team while enhancing technical and collaborative skills.

responsibilities: Developed mobile games, including a trivia mobile game and a functional mobile application using Flutter and Dart.
Collaborated on designing and developing a database system as a university project, demonstrating web development skills.
Worked on various projects in C++ with a focus on Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
Strengthened problem-solving abilities through projects related to Data Structures and Algorithms with significant impact.
